title: Which country grows the most pumpkins? It's not America.
description:
India grows the most pumpkins: 9.33 million tonnes of pumpkins, squash and gourds in 2024, by FAO's count. China is second (7.65), then Egypt, Russia and Ukraine; the United States is sixth with 0.93 million tonnes, about a tenth of India. Happy Halloween.

Sources:
- FAOSTAT Production: Crops and livestock products, item Pumpkins, squash and gourds, 2024 (bulk download) — Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations: https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/Production_Crops_Livestock_E_All_Data_(Normalized).zip

Labels: FAO counts pumpkins, squash and gourds as one crop. India's and the US figures are official; China's and Ukraine's are FAO estimates, and Egypt's and Russia's are imputed by FAO. China means mainland China. Flags: official SVGs from Wikimedia Commons. Narration is a synthetic voice (Kokoro-82M). Music generated with ACE-Step 1.5; Some sound effects generated with Stable Audio Open (Stability AI).
